competitors.title: Learn Why All Feelings Are Okay With Jay & Neil!
Balloon Feelings Game (Buildy Wildy and MEOWJI)

angle: Learning goal: recognise happy, sad, surprised. Story: Pip builds a block tower (happy), it wobbles and tumbles softly (sad, brief), Tiko helps rebuild and pops a flag on top (surprised -> happy). For each feeling Tiko asks 'How does Pip feel?', pause, then the word appears. Ends: 'All feelings are okay - and friends help.'
hook: Pip built the tallest tower! ...Wobble, wobble...
strengths: Character rig already has happy/sad/wow moods - almost no new assets; complete mini-narrative; strong parent appeal
weaknesses: Sad beat must stay brief and soft; crowded category; 'surprised' face must not read as scared
